tagline: Batik Tangerang Selatan with a local-craft point of view.

story.title: Batik Tangerang Selatan with a local-craft point of view.
story.body: Profil NFC ini menempatkan karya batik Tangerang Selatan sebagai fokus utama. Detail motif, katalog, harga, dan kanal publik belum dipaksakan sebelum sumber primer tersedia.

highlights.title: Buyer discovery
highlights.body: A concise profile for retail, boutique, gifting and buyer introductions.

highlights.title: Local identity
highlights.body: The page keeps the Tangsel origin visible without inventing unverified heritage claims.

highlights.title: Direct channels
highlights.body: Only channels supplied by the handover or public sources are published.

highlights.title: NFC ready
highlights.body: Mobile-first layout with large tap targets for exhibition use.

verification.note: Public search found a Titik Kurniasih operating 'Dapur Bu Batik' in Alam Sutera, but this conflicts with the TEI handover category 'Batik Tangsel'. The profile therefore remains handover-verified until the exact TEI business identity is confirmed.
